<!--
贡献指南见 CONTRIBUTING.md。推之前跑一次 make check——它就是 CI 会跑的全部。
Contributing guide: CONTRIBUTING.md. Run `make check` before pushing; it is everything CI runs.
-->

## 这个改动做了什么 / What this changes

<!-- 一两句。「为什么」比「怎么做」重要——怎么做 diff 里已经有了。 -->
<!-- A sentence or two. The "why" matters more than the "how"; the diff already has the how. -->

## 怎么确认它是对的 / How you know it works

<!--
跑了什么、看到了什么。改行为的话，最有说服力的是：先复现出旧行为，再展示新行为。
What you ran and what you saw. For a behaviour change, the convincing form is:
reproduce the old behaviour first, then show the new one.
-->

- [ ] `make check` 通过 / passes

## 考虑过但没采用的 / Considered and rejected

<!--
可留空。但如果这个改动有另一种明显的写法而你没选它，写一句为什么——
这往往是评审最需要、又最少拿到的信息。
Optional. But if there was an obvious alternative you did not take, say why in one line.
That is usually the part a reviewer most needs and least often gets.
-->

## 相关 issue / Related issues

<!-- Closes #123 -->
